gate_reason: Dual authorization not complete. Candidate state must not propagate to EHR until both authority_requirements and evidence_requirements are satisfied.
conditions_for_rejection: Either clinician's authority cannot be confirmed within the authorization window
Evidence of minimum necessary standard is found to be incomplete after submission
rollback_trigger: If either authorization is later found invalid, adopted state (if it proceeds) must be flagged and all downstream EHR states derived from this recommendation must be reopened for reverification.
